name: LogoSpotlightWall
job: A grid of client logos where hovering one dims the rest and shows a one-line result beneath it
mobile: 3-column grid, tap shows result in a line below
motion: others fade and lower contrast, result text slides up (reduced-motion: instant dim, no slide)
art_direction: Boardroom stone: warm limestone ground, charcoal logos at rest, a single copper underline on the chosen one
